title: Secret Santa Gifts for the Hair & Beauty Lover – OLAPLEX Inc.
summary: Explore OLAPLEX’s top Secret Santa beauty picks including hair masks, lash and brow serums, and kits designed to deliver professional-level results at home.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


- OLAPLEX® gifts are practical and luxurious, combining daily usability with salon-quality results.
- There are gifts for every beauty lover – from fine hair to bold brows, there’s an option to match anyone’s self-care ritual.
- Secret Santa is made simple when you are able to choose from a variety of hair masks, serums, and kits for universally loved beauty gifts.


****


## Secret Santa Gifts for the Hair & Beauty Lover


The holiday season is filled with festivities and cheer, sparkling lights, and of course, lots of gift giving, which sometimes includes a Secret Santa exchange. Choosing the right gift for your Secret Santa can feel daunting, but for the hair and beauty enthusiast in your life, OLAPLEX® has got you covered. From indulgent treatments to everyday essentials, these science-backed solutions make it easy to gift a thoughtful, luxurious present that anyone would be thrilled to unwrap this holiday season.


## Transformative Hair Masks


Few things say self-care like a hair mask. For the friend who loves to pamper themselves, a mask is the kind of gift that feels lavish while also giving them amazing restorative benefits to their hair. The[Weightless Nourishing Mask](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-weightless-nourishing-mask-200ml) is perfect for finer hair types, offering hydration after 5 washes* without the extra heaviness and 2x instant, all-day volume. It immediately boosts shine, reduces breakage, and helps prevent snapping wash after wash to support length retention over time. ****


If your Secret Santa has thicker or a more medium to course hair texture, the[Rich Hydration Mask](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-rich-hydration-mask-200ml) makes a thoughtful choice. This deeply restorative mask is formulated with Biomimetic Cuticle Technology to lock in intense hydration and strength, sealing hair cuticles to up to 5 washes to prevent moisture loss.


Both masks use OLAPLEX®’s bond-building technology to repair hair at the molecular level, making them the ultimate blend of luxury and long-term care. ****


## Elevated Lash & Brow Care


Secret Santa gifts often fall into two categories: practical or playful. But nothing delights more than something truly unexpected. For the beauty enthusiast, the[LashBond™ Building Serum](https://olaplex.com/collections/lash-and-brows/products/olaplex-lashbond-building-serum) is just that gift. Instead of another mascara, this serum works behind the scenes to support lashes that look longer, thicker, and more dense.


If brows are more their obsession the[BrowBond™ Building Serum](https://olaplex.com/collections/lash-and-brows/products/olaplex-browbond-building-serum) is the perfect match. It works to condition and strengthen the delicate hairs, encouraging fuller-looking brows in as little as 4 weeks, and for optimal results, it is recommended that the serum be used in the AM & PM on clean, dry skin. For a complete routine that they are sure to love, gift both the LashBond® and the BrowBond™ Serum to your Secret Santa.


### Gift Sets for Every Beauty Lover


Sometimes choosing just one product feels impossible. That’s where OLAPLEX®’s array of[Value Sets](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets) come in handy. With curated selections of fan favorites, each kit delivers a full routine in one beautifully packaged set.


From the[Strength & Shine Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-strength-and-shine-set) to the[Hydration Heroes Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-hydration-heroes-set) , there’s something for everyone. Kits can also be gifted as a whole or split up into multiple smaller presents, a Secret Santa hack that ensures everyone gets a little something extraordinary.


## How Do You Pick the Right Secret Santa Gift?


Secret Santa gifting doesn’t have to be predictable. With OLAPLEX®, you can give the gift of confidence, indulgence, and self-care all wrapped up in one. From transformative hair masks to lash and brow help, and kits designed to delight any beauty icon, these presents make holiday gifting effortless and unforgettable.


****


### Total Hair Repair Set


For the person who is always talking about hair health, choose a set focused on strengthening and repairing the look and feel of damaged hair.


[Total Hair Repair Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-total-hair-repair-set) has everything you need for stronger, softer, visibly healthier hair. This OLAPLEX holiday set includes:


- [OLAPLEX Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment-100ml) prewash to strengthen hair
- [Nº.4 Bond Maintenance™ Strengthening Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n4-bond-maintenance-strengthening-shampoo-250ml) , which is the perfect holiday shampoo to strengthen and hydrate hair
- [Nº.5 Bond Maintenance™](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us)[Strengthening](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n5-bond-maintenance-strengthening-conditioner-250ml)[Conditioner](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n5-bond-maintenance-strengthening-conditioner-250ml) to smooth and strengthen hair


Hairstylist and[OLAPLEX Global Ambassador](https://olaplex.com/pages/hair-care-ambassadors) Naeemah LaFond recommends the set as a complete reset: “If I'm gifting someone who's had a rough hair year, the Total Hair Repair Set is the one. Nº.3PLUS, Nº.4, and Nº.5 together are basically a reset button: repair, strengthen, and hydrate in one simple routine.”


### The Strength & Shine Set


Give the gift of stronger hair with[The Strength & Shine Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-strength-and-shine-set) . This haircare gift set includes:


- [OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™](https://olaplex.com/collections/styling/products/olaplex-n-7-bonding-oil-30ml) for instant shine and protection


### Iconic Stylers Set


Who doesn’t love shiny hair? The[Iconic Stylers Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-iconic-stylers-set) contains two key products for shinier, smoother hair and heat protection:


- [Nº.6 Bond Smoother®](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-6-bond-smoother-us) to smooth, hydrate, reduce breakage, and provide heat protection
- [OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-7-bonding-oil-us) for instant shine and protection


### The Key To Shine Set


[The Key To Shine Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-the-key-to-shine-set) contains a trio of mini OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oils™ plus a limited-edition keychain for effortless, high-shine hair that travels with you. This set includes:


- An exclusive keychain to keep your glow within reach


Hairstylist and OLAPLEX Global Ambassador Jenna Perry calls Nº.7 Bonding Oil™ a crowd-pleasing gift: “Nº.7 Bonding Oil™ is always one of my favorite products to gift because it feels luxurious but is also incredibly useful. It’s one of those products that almost everyone can incorporate into their routine.”


### The Hydration Heroes Set


[The Hydration Heroes Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-hydration-heroes-set) is the perfect way to give your loved ones hydrated, healthy-looking hair with every wash. This healthy hair set contains:


- [Nº.4 Bond Maintenance™ Strengthening Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n4-bond-maintenance-strengthening-shampoo-250ml) to strengthen and hydrate hair
- [Rich Hydration Mask](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us) to smooth and hydrate hair


“This time of year, the conversation between stylist and client tends to be a lot about dryness, breakage and static with the constant cold to warm environments, heating inside and cold outside and the constant go between. Hydration Heroes is great for dryness complaints; the masks are key here,” says hairstylist and OLAPLEX Global Ambassador Halley Brisker.
